in_arabic.name: Riha
in_arabic.long_meaning: Riha هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic word 'Rihah' which means 'a flow' or 'a river'. This name carries the essence of continuous renewal and the power of the flowing water. It symbolizes the journey of life and the constant change it brings.
